name: Codex transport
responsibility: One newline-framed JSON object at a time each way, correlated to its request, and each tool call routed to the owner registered for its namespace
description: The versioned wire contract it decodes against lives beside it in codex-protocol. A dynamic tool call reaches the owner registered for its namespace and manifest digest: the thread tools, the coordinator tools, or tell_coordinator.

outgoing.label: a tool call from a thread
notifications and tool calls, routed by thread
outgoing.description: The server composes the tab-session owner and passes routing or lookup callbacks through the public runtime or Browser gateway interfaces. Private server code registers and invokes those callbacks; the runtime modules never import codex-workbench-sessions.ts.
